name: AutoSubSync
description: Automatically synchronizes external and embedded subtitles across your library, aligning each one against the audio of the media it belongs to. The sync engine is downloaded once on first use and verified against a checksum built into the plugin.
overview: Automatically synchronizes external and embedded subtitles across your library.

versions.changelog: Every subtitle is now scored against the video's own audio, before and after syncing. A subtitle the audio already agrees with is left alone and never handed to the engine, and a result the audio disagrees with is discarded instead of written to your library. Results produced before 1.2.4.0 were never checked against the audio; if any of them are wrong, Roll back everything restores your originals. Maximum offset and Minimum offset are gone, automatic sync on new media and refresh after sync now default to off, and the status panel separates subtitles refused by the audio check from failures.
